description: Industry-agnostic web queries for company discovery with stronger third-party coverage and data-center/security signals. (Tip: to disambiguate generic names, your caller can inject extra negatives like -site:rbi.org.in -"Reserve Bank of India" when {{company}} == "RBI Insurance".)

categories.name: Corporate & Official Sources
queries: (site:{{domain}} OR site:news.{{domain}} OR site:newsroom.{{domain}} OR site:media.{{domain}} OR site:press.{{domain}}) (news OR newsroom OR press OR media OR announcements OR updates)
(site:{{domain}} OR site:investors.{{domain}} OR site:ir.{{domain}}) (investor OR investors OR IR OR "10-K" OR 10Q OR "10-Q" OR "annual report" OR earnings OR presentations OR events)
site:{{domain}} (blog OR insights OR updates) -careers -jobs

categories.name: Financial Filings & Capital Markets
queries: "{{company}}" site:sec.gov (8-K OR 10-K OR 10-Q OR "current report" OR "earnings call")
"{{company}}" ("credit facility" OR refinancing OR "notes offering" OR debt OR financing) (site:investors.{{domain}} OR site:ir.{{domain}} OR site:sec.gov)

categories.name: Jobs & Hiring Signals
queries: (site:{{domain}} OR site:careers.{{domain}}) (careers OR jobs OR "we're hiring" OR openings)
site:linkedin.com/jobs {{company}} (engineer OR manager OR director OR analyst OR compliance OR security OR SRE OR "data center")
site:indeed.com {{company}} (security OR compliance OR analyst OR developer OR "data center")
site:myworkdayjobs.com {{company}}
site:greenhouse.io {{company}}
site:boards.greenhouse.io {{company}}
site:jobs.lever.co {{company}}
site:lever.co {{company}}

categories.name: Market, News & Analyst Reports
queries: "{{company}}" (announces OR launches OR partnership OR investment OR acquisition OR funding OR recall)
"{{company}}" (analyst OR report OR coverage OR forecast OR rating)
"{{company}}" (earnings OR "quarterly results" OR profit OR loss OR growth)
"{{company}}" site:reuters.com (news OR business)
"{{company}}" site:bloomberg.com
"{{company}}" (press release) (site:businesswire.com OR site:prnewswire.com OR site:globenewswire.com)

categories.name: Risk, Compliance & Security
queries: "{{company}}" (breach OR incident OR outage OR vulnerability OR recall OR "regulatory action")
"{{company}}" (compliance OR audit OR fine OR sanction OR GDPR OR "SOC 2" OR "ISO 27001" OR DORA OR NIS2)
"{{company}}" (lawsuit OR investigation OR fraud OR whistleblower)
"{{company}}" (cybersecurity OR ransomware OR exfiltration OR "data loss")
"{{company}}" (regulator OR enforcement) (site:ftc.gov OR site:sec.gov OR site:ico.org.uk OR site:cnil.fr)

categories.name: Technology & Operations (General)
queries: "{{company}}" (cloud OR migration OR "legacy systems" OR "data platform" OR "AI initiative" OR SASE OR "Zero Trust")
"{{company}}" (supply chain OR manufacturing OR logistics OR "operational delay")
"{{company}}" (efficiency OR automation OR modernization)

categories.name: Technology & Operations (Data Center / AI)
queries: "{{company}}" (colocation OR interconnection OR "data center" OR IBX OR "xScale" OR "Equinix Metal" OR "Fabric")
"{{company}}" (GPU OR NVIDIA OR AI OR "H100" OR "B200" OR "AI cluster" OR "high density")
"{{company}}" ("liquid cooling" OR immersion OR "direct-to-chip" OR cooling)
"{{company}}" (power OR PUE OR "power usage effectiveness" OR megawatt OR MW OR substation OR capacity)

categories.name: Sustainability & Energy
queries: "{{company}}" (renewable OR PPA OR "power purchase agreement" OR solar OR wind OR geothermal OR "clean energy")
"{{company}}" (emissions OR "scope 1" OR "scope 2" OR "scope 3" OR SBTi OR "science-based targets")
"{{company}}" (PUE OR efficiency OR "energy efficiency") (site:{{domain}} OR site:investors.{{domain}})

categories.name: Customer & Product
queries: "{{company}}" (case study OR "customer story" OR testimonial OR reference)
"{{company}}" (RFP OR RFI OR tender)
"{{company}}" (product OR platform OR portfolio OR roadmap OR deprecate OR "end-of-life" OR EOL)
"{{company}}" (launch OR update OR version OR feature)

categories.name: M&A, Geography & Expansion
queries: "{{company}}" (acquires OR acquisition OR acquired OR divests OR spin-off)
"{{company}}" (opens OR opening OR expands OR expansion OR greenfield OR brownfield OR campus) ("data center" OR IBX OR facility OR region OR country)
"{{company}}" (joint venture OR JV OR partnership) (xScale OR GIC OR PGIM OR Blackstone OR Brookfield)
